last_action: All 7 tasks complete; 82 unit tests, package CLI startup, manifest validation, and diff whitespace check passed.

FR-001.title: The setup operation MUST prepare memory for the workspace from a single user-invoked operation.

FR-002.title: Setup MUST preserve existing workspace configuration and user-authored instructions, changing only missing settings and content within its managed instruction section unless the user explicitly requests replacement.

FR-003.title: Setup MUST verify that the memory service can be launched with the configured server version or report the prerequisite or installation failure that prevents launch.

FR-004.title: Setup MUST initialize the workspace's host-specific store and add eligible records from other workstations without overwriting existing records.

FR-005.title: Setup MUST report records changed on another workstation for later reconciliation and MUST NOT silently choose a conflicting version.

FR-006.title: Setup MUST check known MCP registration locations for competing memory-service registrations and report incomplete checks when a configuration cannot be read or understood.

FR-007.title: When setup changes settings that require reconnection, it MUST request a restart through the active client when supported; otherwise it MUST provide an actionable manual restart instruction and report that restart is pending.

FR-008.title: Setup MUST distinguish completed provisioning from a running connection that still requires restart, and MUST NOT claim that the active service uses the workspace store before reconnection is verified.

FR-009.title: Setup MUST be safe to repeat and MUST NOT create duplicate managed settings, host stores, or instruction content.

FR-010.title: Setup MUST return a failure result for blocking errors and MUST surface warnings without presenting an incomplete configuration check as conflict-free.

expectations: automatic reconciliation of conflicting memory records
restarting clients without a supported restart mechanism
changes to memory creation or retrieval after setup
context: area: plugins/memory-sync CLI, MCP registration, and session-start setup
constraint: preserve existing configuration and report restart pending until the client reconnects
intent: Make workspace memory setup complete, safe to repeat, and explicit about required MCP reconnection.

decisions.decision: Keep restart under the MCP client and report a manual restart action from setup.
decisions.why: The CLI and session hook do not own a portable client restart API.
decisions.rejected: Restarting the client from setup could terminate the process that invoked it and is unsupported across clients.

decisions.decision: Request restart only when setup creates workspace memory configuration or installs the managed server.
decisions.why: Those changes can alter the active connection, while unchanged session-start runs should remain quiet.
decisions.rejected: Always requesting restart would disrupt idempotent repeated setup.

decisions.decision: Represent restart pending separately from provisioning success.
decisions.why: Setup can finish provisioning but cannot observe whether the client reconnected.
decisions.rejected: Failing setup until reconnection would conflate provisioning with client state.

decisions.decision: Treat workspace configuration creation or first installation of the managed server as restart-required changes.
decisions.why: Either can change the server process or store selected by the active MCP connection.
decisions.rejected: Request a restart after every setup run, which would disrupt unchanged session-start runs.

decisions.decision: Keep the client restart manual and report it separately from provisioning success.
decisions.why: The CLI has no portable way to restart or verify the MCP host process.
decisions.rejected: Attempting to restart the host from its own setup hook could interrupt setup and is unsupported across clients.

decisions.decision: Suppress the generic initialization restart recommendation only when setup calls initialization.
decisions.why: Setup now gives conditional restart guidance, while standalone init still needs its existing follow-up instructions.
decisions.rejected: Changing standalone init behavior would regress existing users.

plan.summary: Plan a restart-aware result for existing idempotent workspace setup.
plan.key_finding: Setup does not control or verify the MCP host process, so it must distinguish provisioning from restart completion.

tasks.summary: Five tasks across one user-story phase and Polish; tests precede implementation, with independent docs and CI validation afterward.

implement.summary: Setup now reports conditional MCP restart guidance, preserves standalone init messaging, and passes the full CI validation.
implement.key_finding: Suppressing initialization's unconditional follow-up is necessary for unchanged setup runs to stay quiet.

approach: Track workspace configuration creation and managed server installation in the existing setup path. On successful provisioning, report a restart action only when these server-affecting inputs change, and document that setup cannot verify client reconnection.

T001.did: Added restart behavior regression tests and confirmed the new scenarios fail before implementation.

T003.did: Documented when setup requires a restart and how to restart the MCP connection.

T007.did: Added an opt-out for initialization follow-up guidance when called by setup, preserving standalone init output; setup and init tests pass.
